# Run these manually after reviewing the generated files:

flask db migrate -m "add plugin marketplace models"
flask db upgrade

# Optional sample data
python3 scripts/seed_plugin_marketplace.py

# Useful route checks
grep -n "plugin_marketplace_bp" src/app.py
grep -n "/api/plugins" src/api/plugin_marketplace_routes.py

# Start app
python3 src/app.py
